en: A colorized historic postcard view of a European town square lined with multi‑story buildings featuring steep red roofs and ornate façades. In the foreground is a large square with café tables and umbrellas surrounding a monumental fountain or statue ensemble. In the background, on a hill, stands a prominent clock tower with large clock faces, part of a fortified structure. The caption printed at the top left reads "GRAZ, Hauptplatz," indicating the main square of Graz.
